target_semantics.classification_basis: active buy/sell orders; Tushare states data are based on L2 orders

infoway_public_capabilities.depth_scope: real-time top-5 bid/ask price and volume

live_probe_evidence.workflow: DAO2 A Infoway Semantic Capability Probe V1

reconstruction_assessment.reason: Tushare moneyflow bucket semantics are based on active buy/sell L2 orders. Infoway public trade events expose trade-level price/value/direction but do not expose original order identifiers or a documented original-order aggregation rule needed to prove the same large/extra-large order buckets.
reconstruction_assessment.reason_depth: Top-5 snapshots are real-time book states, not historical executed order provenance and cannot reconstruct the exact historical active-order buckets.

minimum_requirements: A-share historical coverage for every residual date from 2020-06-08 through 2023-05-22
historical tick/order records with active buy/sell direction

original order identifier or documented original-order aggregate amount sufficient to reproduce Tushare 200k-1m and >=1m buckets, OR direct fields exactly equivalent to Tushare buy_lg_amount/buy_elg_amount/sell_lg_amount/sell_elg_amount
auditable raw bytes / API response provenance
Jessica pinned-archive field-level exact-match on overlapping non-residual rows before any target row is admitted

decision.next_action: Obtain explicit Infoway custom-plan confirmation or endpoint documentation for deep historical A-share tick/order or exact moneyflow data. Do not purchase/upgrade a standard plan for Module A because all 16 residual dates predate the published Professional 3-year window as of 2026-09-21.
